description: Start here: the size and recent growth of the MCP server ecosystem in one call. Returns the total number of servers in the Official MCP Registry, new servers in the last 7 and 30 days, the 3 latest MCP and A2A spec changes with source links, and the snapshot date. Good for 'How big is the MCP ecosystem and what changed lately?'. Example: ecosystem_overview() -> {total_servers, new_servers_last_7_days, new_servers_last_30_days, latest_spec_changes, snapshot_date}. No arguments.
name: ecosystem_overview
